v2-u06.text: You won't feel it, and you don't feel the high pressure either, but over the years high pressure damages the heart, the brain and the kidneys.
So you take it every day, even when you feel fine.

v2-u08.text: Please don't change the dose yourself.
If your readings are high, write them down and tell me at your next visit.

v3-u19.text: No, please don't take an extra tablet on your own.
One high reading doesn't mean the dose is wrong; I look at all your readings together, and that's why we're adding losartan today.

v3-u20.text: If it's high, sit down, rest five minutes and measure again, then write it down for me.
If it's above 180 on top, or you have chest pain, weakness on one side or slurred speech, call 995.
